title: Keto Cedar Plank Salmon with Midnight Marinated Squid
description: A flavorful and keto-friendly seafood dish featuring cedar plank salmon and midnight marinated squid, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Cedar plank
ingredients.notes: Soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together midnight olive oil, lime juice, and minced garlic.
3. Thread the squid tubes onto the cedar plank, leaving a little space between each piece.
4. Brush the cedar plank with the midnight marinade, making sure each piece of squid is coated.
5. Season the salmon fillet with salt and black pepper.
6. Place the salmon fillet on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
7. Meanwhile, grill the squid for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it's cooked through.
8. Remove the cedar plank from the grill and let it rest for 2-3 minutes.
9. Serve the grilled salmon and squid together, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
10. Enjoy your delicious keto cedar plank salmon with midnight marinated squid!
11. Be sure to store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
